pitches.logline: Levan, driving his dark-blue BMW to a friend's supra outside town, wants the pin his friend sent, but the link is just a jumble of letters he can't turn into a route.
pitches.hook: The phone in the holder buzzes; the friend yells through the speaker that the khinkali are getting cold. Sound: real-phone-buzz
pitches.heroObject: a shared map link on the phone

pitches.logline: Dato squints at a small phone in a wobbly holder while his new car's wide screen plays the radio; his wife can't believe it, and the holder is about to give up.
pitches.hook: The light goes green, Dato leans in to read the tiny arrow, a horn blasts behind and Tamar snaps about the big screen. Sound: horn-short

pitches.logline: Nini has to get a three-tier birthday cake across town in her grey van, but the speed bumps and a railway crossing keep wrecking it.
pitches.hook: The van hits a bump with a hard clunk, the cake box jumps in the mirror and Nini shrieks. Sound: real-suspension-creak

treatment.logline: Dato squints at a small phone in a wobbly holder while his new car's wide screen plays the radio; his wife Tamar can't believe it, until he plugs the iPhone in and the navigator moves onto the car's screen with CarPlay.
treatment.hero: Dato, mid 40s, knit jumper, side-parted greying hair, short beard; his wife Tamar beside him, quoted by the narrator; their white crossover in one city drive
treatment.obstacle: the arrow on a small phone in a cheap holder is unreadable while the car's big screen only plays the radio

hook.event: the light is green, Dato leans in to read the tiny arrow, a horn blasts behind and Tamar's line lands

act1: the arrow is too small to read and the horns behind count up
over a pothole the holder snaps and the phone drops to the floor
the phone lies on the floor while the big screen keeps playing the radio
treatment.turn: a beat of silence, Dato pulls over with the hazards on, then the cable clicks into the port

reveal.what: the car's own screen swaps from the radio to CarPlay with VINARI on it, then the route preview

screens.step: plug in: VINARI on the car's screen
the turn in Georgian with its arrow
the same navigator on the phone, search without internet

treatment.payoff: the same couple at their building, calm; Tamar: „აი, ახლა კი ჩანს.“
treatment.signature: the ink cable rises into the port under the car's screen, clicks, and the radio wipes into the real CarPlay home
